params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

overloads.semanticRole: Sets the font used to display the object(s) designated by object and * to the named font, for the current process.

constraints: Applying this command to an object that was using a style sheet automatically removes the style-sheet reference from the object, even if the assigned font matches the style sheet's.
